shared_elements: low-relief outline figures on a common groundline
horizontal band of repeated motifs across the top (inscription band / rosette band)
single register of figures walking or facing rightward
justification: Both show profile human figures in shallow outline relief standing on a common groundline beneath a horizontal band of repeated small motifs, and in each a figure grasps a thin vertical staff-like object. But A is a group of closely spaced human figures facing one another with no animals, while B is dominated by a large humped quadruped led by a single attendant, so the actual subject and figure-to-figure relationships differ substantially.
